policy: External production dependencies remain blocked until exact-release, provider-backed evidence is independently reviewed. Code, mocks, vendor marketing claims and unsigned screenshots are not sufficient.

workstreams.name: Private object storage and origin isolation
workstreams.acceptance: Production bucket is private, encrypted, least-privilege, region-approved and isolated from public origins; exact deployed controls and byte-level access tests pass.

workstreams.name: Content lifecycle and CDN revocation
workstreams.acceptance: A real provider synchronously quarantines/unpublishes and propagates revocation through source objects, derivatives, replicas, backups where applicable, caches, CDN, shared links and merchant surfaces; failure injection proves no stale delivery.

workstreams.name: Licensed face masking and safety/FCI evidence
workstreams.acceptance: The exact detector/runtime and safety/FCI providers have documented commercial rights, immutable model/data digests, representative subgroup evaluation, calibrated thresholds, signed reports and failure-mode tests.

workstreams.name: Independent privacy assessment
workstreams.acceptance: An assessor independent of implementation verifies exact deployed ingress, processing, storage, publication, restore and deletion routes; zero unmasked escape; consent/revocation; child safeguards; and deletion propagation.

workstreams.name: Licensed reconstruction and rendering models
workstreams.acceptance: Commercial-use rights cover the complete model, weights, preprocessing, runtime and transitive dependencies; immutable revisions and data-processing terms are approved.

workstreams.name: Persistent private Twin assets and deletion
workstreams.acceptance: Real private storage, consent-bound registry, owner-scoped reads, revocation, deletion outbox, backup/restore and cross-surface deletion are exercised in deployed staging.

workstreams.name: Look It processor/provider approval
workstreams.acceptance: Any external processor is contractually approved for purpose, region, retention, training use, subprocessors, deletion and incident notification; request-time consent and revocation are verified.

workstreams.name: Twin and Look It independent quality evaluation
workstreams.acceptance: Pre-registered human-reviewed evaluation covers capture conditions, body/skin-tone/market/device slices, geometry and retrieval quality, uncertainty, failure rates and deletion; holdout data is untouched by tuning.

workstreams.name: Telemetry, alert routing and named ownership
workstreams.acceptance: All production services emit privacy-safe telemetry to approved private collectors; dashboards, SLO alerts and test notifications reach named on-call owners with acknowledged delivery.

workstreams.name: Incident exercises and rollback evidence
workstreams.acceptance: Privacy, provider outage, payment, database restore and rollback exercises are executed in deployed staging; measured RPO/RTO, reconciliation, independent approval and post-exercise actions are recorded.
